output.narrative:
Revenue experienced a severe decrease of -779.47 (-0.9952 relative delta), driven primarily by a collapse in requests (-779.06 contribution). Across the identity factors, ctr moved from 0.011108 to 0.012953. 

When drilling into ctr, primary segments emerged across ad formats and geography. Specifically, ad_format=rewarded showed a disproportionate impact with an explanatory power of -125.602 and a lift of -1451.86, while country=AR also drove movement with an explanatory power of -4.984 and a lift of -199.35. Going deeper within ad_format=rewarded, the drop was further concentrated in vertical=gaming (explanatory power 5.184, lift 88.56) and device_model=iPhone 15 (explanatory power 20.27, lift 101.35). Going deeper within country=AR, the movement concentrated in ad_format=rewarded (explanatory power 27.918, lift 279.18) and os_version=Android 12 (explanatory power -21.925, lift -143.4). 

Meanwhile, dimensions such as publisher_tier (with tier_2 showing a lift of 1.0) were checked and ruled out as proportional or lacking meaningful explanatory share.
